## Summary

Senior web developer and Tech Lead teams escalate to for feasibility calls, WordPress root-cause, and hard delivery — with strong PHP, CSS, and JavaScript on Webflow and WordPress, plus React and Next.js for full-stack products. Made the call that seat-level booking could ship inside WordPress; recovered a year-delayed web + mobile product by resyncing drifted stacks and shipping in 3 months; was the WordPress and front-end reference at Your Digital Resource. Ships faster with agentic AI (Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, MCP) for US clients. Fluent in English (EF SET C2) and Spanish; remote-ready.

## Judgment Calls

### Seat-level booking inside WordPress — Nicasource
Team split on whether a client seat-reservation system needed a separate app. Made the call that WordPress could carry seats, availability, and bookings via custom post types and meta. Shipped on one codebase instead of two systems to sync forever.

### Year-late web + mobile rescue — AIM Services
Hired onto a product a year past deadline. Web and mobile had drifted onto duplicated, out-of-sync logic. Put both sides back on one source of truth, cleared the backlog, and shipped to production in 3 months.

### Multi-layer cache escalation — Your Digital Resource
Developers shipped changes that never appeared because a cache layer still served the old copy. Became the person this got escalated to; diagnosed across the chain and optimized the layers so it stopped recurring. Standing reference for WordPress and front-end; onboarded new developers and coached the team through Webflow and CSS stuck points.
